conceptRationale: The owner-approved visual direction is the Connected O paired with the compact, bold lowercase oorva wordmark shown in the light reference. The symbol reads as two rounded opposing arcs with open side breaks; the letterforms use close, even spacing and a single-storey a.
geometryRationale: The symbol uses original cubic Bézier arcs with rounded ends and two controlled side openings. The custom lowercase o-o-r-v-a paths use broad rounded counters, a compact r shoulder, a rounded V join, and a single-storey a. The paths are independently authored vector geometry, not a raster trace or live font rendering.

originalityProvenance.authorship: Original Bézier symbol and custom lowercase letter paths authored for this Oorva candidate. No third-party mark was copied or traced.

visualDirection.ownerFeedback: The previous logo was rejected as different; use this design as the visual direction.
visualDirection.scope: Approval establishes visual direction and a standing D03b selection rule; this O01L source revision is not itself a selected O01X export. D03c public rights clearance and PNG export approval are not granted.

originalityProvenance.inputUse: The light reference is owner-approved visual direction; related dark, transparent, monochrome, and symbol exports provide supplemental visual direction. No PNG paths were copied or traced, and no raster was embedded.
originalityProvenance.wordmarkConstruction: Hand-authored lowercase vector paths; all master files contain no live text, font, or external resource.

smallSizeEvidence.method: The symbol SVG's actual M/C path endpoints are paired at each open side. Euclidean endpoint distance is reduced by the sum of the round-cap radii, then scaled by logicalSize / 256.
smallSizeEvidence.gapFormula: gapUnits = hypot(upperEndpointX - lowerEndpointX, upperEndpointY - lowerEndpointY) - (upperStrokeWidth + lowerStrokeWidth) / 2; gapPx = gapUnits * logicalSizePx / sourceViewBoxWidth
smallSizeEvidence.visualInspection: The two side openings remain distinct at each requested size; the 20px master retains a 2.5px computed gap on each side. The reference PNG remains visual direction only; no raster export or device rendering is claimed by this stage.

tagline.placement: Separate app text; not part of SVG wordmark geometry or any SVG master.
tagline.fontSource: Bundled Inter 400 for separate tagline rendering; runtime font loading is not validated by O01L.

contrastEvidence.standard: WCAG relative luminance and contrast ratio for sRGB colors
contrastEvidence.channelLinearization: cLinear = cSrgb / 12.92 when cSrgb <= 0.04045; otherwise ((cSrgb + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4, where cSrgb is the 0-1 channel value.
